title: The Veil
blurb: Stillness, spirit sight and leaving your body.

steps.text: Meditate: sneak and hold G, standing still.
steps.hint: A ring of dots fills round the crosshair. Meditating doubles your energy regeneration.

steps.text: Spend time in the Veil, out of your body.

steps.hint: Spirits tell what the place used to be.

steps.text: Find a secret only the Veil shows.

finish.line: You have seen behind the Veil.
